artist.name: Amrisha
artist.bio: Amrisha Singh is a London-based DJ and radio presenter who plays eclectic, soulful and percussive music from around the world. Her long-running show A Worldwide Thing started on Delhi online station Radio 79, has been on boxout.fm since the station began, and has aired on Worldwide FM, Jazz FM and Voices Radio.

eras.sound: Global underground music, from soul and funk to tropical bass
